title: New Orleans clarinetists who impressed Lewis
summary: Lewis lists clarinetists he admired in New Orleans, including Charlie McCurtis, Picou, Baquet, Tio and George Boyd, and says each had a style of his own.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
